answer: Price every identity to a scarce hardware anchor that must sign a fresh proof each epoch, and let standing accrue only as already-established peers from SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign your audited work. Trust soaks in slowly, like pigment into cloth, one deliberate quill-stroke endorsement at a time. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares a single root, so its vouches fold back on themselves and never span distinct clusters; honest standing stays as rare as saffron picked thread by thread, while a farm pays a fresh anchor per head.
